notes.title: UPDATE: Joystick sensitivity option Added
notes.notes:
Now you can adjust the joystick sensitivity of the game.
Some tutorial prompts and a music update was fixed as well.

notes.title: Issues with languages and Save Files - Patch 02/18/2019
notes.notes:
Yesterday we uploaded a patch that added support the Nvidia Shield Controller but we missed enabling the steam connection. Now we fixed it with this new patch so all the languages are now enabled. These might caused three issues

Your save files didn't show the current level
This happened because the game wasn't connected with steam. This patch should solve your issue.

You started playing the game on Sunday and now the progress is gone
Now that the game connects to steam, it can save your game taking in mind your user id to connect to steam cloud.

Go to
 %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/La Cosa Entertainment/KLAUS/
You will find a KLAUS_SAVE_DATA.sav. Move this file to the folder with a big number (that's your steam ID)

The game only shows English language
This new patch fixed this issue.

If you're still having some issues. Email me at vvelasco@la-cosa.net

Thanks to Unger Wolfgang for letting us know about the issue
Best

notes.title: Patch 02/06/2019
notes.notes: We recently uploaded a patch fixing some languages issues for German and Russian and fixed a sound volume setup at the beginning of each scene.

notes.title: Working on Russian Language Patch
notes.notes:
We noticed that sometimes Russian language is not loaded.
We're working on a patch to solve this. It should be up before the end of today

notes.title: Language Patch / Russian Language Font error
notes.notes:
Now it's possible to change the game language through the properties of the game in your library.

There's a small bug the first time you run the game on Russian where you have to close the app and open it again in order to load the fonts. We're working on a patch for these, but for the moment, just close and open the app if this happens.
